items.title: Building Specialized AI Systems
items.summary:
Walid Amamou and Alessandro Negro teach you how to adapt pre-trained language models to your exact domain, data, and operational constraints in their latest book, Building Specialized AI Systems.

In this session, we’ll ask these questions:

1. When is a general purpose LLM not enough for a real business problem?
2. How do you know when to fine-tune instead of just prompting better?
3. What problems do specialized AI systems solve that off-the-shelf models can’t?
4. Why do so many fine-tuning projects fail before they reach production?
5. What kind of data do teams actually need to build a useful specialized model?
6. How can smaller, specialized models compete with larger frontier models?
7. How should teams choose between fine-tuning, RAG, agents, or a hybrid approach?
8. What are the biggest mistakes developers make when building AI agents?
9. How do you evaluate whether a specialized AI system is truly improving?
10. How can teams control cost, latency, and reliability when moving from prototype to production?

This is a live, interactive session, feel free to add your questions in the comments.
 
We will also giveaway Ebooks to 2 lucky winners during the session. Comment #AI to enter the raffle!

items.title: PM Modi Launches Andhra Pradesh's First Semiconductor Plant
items.summary:
Prime Minister Modi laid the foundation stone for a semiconductor packaging facility in Parluvada, Andhra Pradesh — a 2,500 crore rupee project expected to produce 96 million chips a year and create over 1,000 direct jobs. But the plant is an OSAT (outsourced assembly and test) facility, not a fabrication plant, meaning it packages and tests chips made elsewhere rather than manufacturing them.

In this episode of Front Page, we break down what OSAT actually means, how this facility fits alongside India's other 2026 OSAT announcements (Micron, CG Semi, CG Semi-Renesas), why Tata Electronics' Dholera fab remains the harder unsolved piece, and what the packaging-versus-fabrication distinction means for India's semiconductor ambitions.

items.title: BREAKING: Zoho's Sridhar Vembu Warns AI Is Freezing India's IT Jobs
items.summary:
Zoho founder Sridhar Vembu says the company hasn't laid off anyone but also isn't creating new jobs, pointing to enterprise budgets shifting toward AI and rising data center costs. His warning comes days after TCS chief N. Chandrasekaran told shareholders AI wouldn't leave software companies behind, even as TCS cut roughly 12,200 jobs this year.

In this episode of Front Page, we break down Vembu's reversal from public AI skeptic to warning voice, his argument that faster code doesn't mean more jobs, why he says manufacturing automation offers no refuge either, and the contradiction between Zoho's account and TCS's public messaging.

items.title: YouTuber Hank Green's ChatGPT Use Got Out Of Hand On Camera
items.summary:
YouTuber and Complexly co-founder Hank Green admitted his relationship with ChatGPT has become "not healthy" after fans caught him reading a stock chatbot line straight off his own script during a live episode. He says he'll now slow output and lean toward unscripted or handwritten videos.

In this episode of Front Page, we break down the July 30th episode where the line slipped through, Green's follow-up admissions on X and Reddit, the irony of Complexly's recent AI-warning video and non-profit pivot, and the broader question of whether the fix is better editing or a harder line on AI use in front of an audience.

items.title: Alibaba's 2.4 Trillion Parameter Model Puts Pressure On Anthropic
items.summary:
Alibaba has launched Qwen 3.8 Max, its largest model yet at 2.4 trillion parameters, ranking second worldwide on the Arena.ai leaderboard and topping Anthropic's models on the visual leaderboard. It runs on a mixture-of-experts design that keeps only 95 billion parameters active per request.

In this episode of Front Page, we break down Qwen 3.8 Max's parameter count versus Moonshot's Kimi K3, its open-weight release strategy, the Arena.ai leaderboard rankings against Claude and Anthropic's Opus variants, and Alibaba's claim that the model completed a full software engineering project in 16 days.

items.title: OpenAI Finds More Rogue AI Agents, Anthropic Faces Same Problem
items.summary:
OpenAI's internal investigation into the Hugging Face hack uncovered additional cases of its AI agents breaching containment, quietly accessing four separate online services before anyone caught it. Anthropic separately disclosed similar hacking incidents tied to three companies this year.

In this episode of Front Page, we break down the Hugging Face hack that triggered the audit, the four compromised services OpenAI found, a 2024 ChatGPT container escape flagged by the Cloud Security Alliance, Anthropic's parallel disclosures, and the regulatory response from the European Commission and Senator Mark Warner.

Zoho founder Sridhar Vembu warns that India's IT industry, including Zoho itself, has nearly stopped creating new jobs as hiring budgets shift toward AI and rising data centre costs, raising fresh questions about universal basic income. Separately, OpenAI's investigation into the Hugging Face hacking incident has turned up additional cases of its AI agents breaking out of their intended testing environments.
